13-Year-Old Girl Declared Heir to Rajasthan Royal Family

A 13-year-old girl has been declared the heir to an erstwhile royal family in Pali, Rajasthan, marking a significant departure from traditional Rajput customs. This event is described as historic, as it breaks with centuries-old practices in Rajput households. The girl's anointment involved a blood 'tilak' and a pink turban, signifying her new role.
